skills.name: accept
skills.description: Accept HQ membership invites from a magic link or raw token.

skills.name: adr
skills.description: Capture qualifying architecture decisions as ADRs in the right HQ or repo location.

skills.name: architect
skills.description: Find shallow modules and propose deepening refactors, ranked with file refs; never edits code. Use when code is hard to change or planning a refactor.

skills.name: ascii-graphic
skills.description: Generate dark ASCII banner graphics for HQ and social launch assets.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.description: Compare approaches to best-in-class prior art, merge existing work, verify cruft removal, and recommend the most durable design before PRD work.

skills.name: calibration-report
skills.description: Summarize estimate accuracy from the assistant time log.

skills.name: capacity
skills.description: Show usage, limits and reset times for every signed-in AI account (Claude, Codex, Grok) as a card in chat, or a table in a terminal.

skills.name: checkpoint
skills.description: Save a lightweight session checkpoint.

skills.name: clean-worktree
skills.description: Merge an HQ worktree branch back into local main, then remove the worktree and branch. Local only; never pushes.

skills.name: cleanup
skills.description: Audit and clean HQ structures, indexes, and stale content.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Vocabulary for designing deep modules and clean interfaces. Triggers: \"deep module\", \"interface design\", \"design it twice\".

skills.name: commit-main
skills.description: Commit every dirty file in the current repo, only when on main.

skills.name: conduct
skills.description: Orchestrator mode: route multi-step work to in-session background subagents (default) or hq worker lanes. Triggers: /conduct, run everything in the background.

skills.name: conduct-join
skills.description: Join this already-running session to a /conduct session as one of its children, so the conductor can send it instructions and receive its reports. Use when the user says "/conduct-join <link>", "join the conductor", "report to the conduct session", or pastes a link id that starts with "cl-". Also handles "leave" to detach.

skills.name: convert-codex
skills.description: Add Codex support to older Claude-first HQ roots without breaking Claude setup.

skills.name: create-skill
skills.description: Create a shared company skill in HQ with a durable identity and ACL governance. Not for personal or local-only skills.

skills.name: daily-brief
skills.description: Build the user's Daily Brief across personal work and every permitted company. Reads the last brief and the user's brief preferences, sweeps sessions, PRs, CI and DMs (plus meeting signals, fleet and connected integrations when a company is bound), writes brief-data.json and brief.json with a launch prompt for every action, and reports status so the desktop app can notify the user. The person's first ready brief adds a welcome edition. Run by the main local bot when the user presses Create brief, or on a schedule.

skills.name: decision-queue
skills.description: Resolve pending user decisions one at a time, one picker per item. The only owner-facing ask path for /super-conductor.

skills.name: deep-plan
skills.description: Deep planning: research subagents plus a 15-question interview for large or strategic PRDs. For light planning use /prd.

skills.name: delegate
skills.description: Hand a project to a person or fleet agent: grants, dossier, ownership transfer, and a pickup DM.

skills.name: deploy
skills.description: Deploy or share generated HQ artifacts through hq-deploy.

skills.name: designate-team
skills.description: Mark a company as HQ Pro cloud-backed and sync its team setup.

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for bugs you cannot reliably reproduce or measure, including perf regressions and flakes. For reproducible bugs use /investigate.

skills.name: discover
skills.description: Pull a repo into HQ and turn parallel exploration into company knowledge and policies. Triggers: \"discover this repo\", \"ingest <repo>\".

skills.name: dm
skills.description: Send or read HQ Sync direct messages — inbox, 1:1 threads, channel history; also prompts, details, or scheduled notes to teammates.

skills.name: dm-bind
skills.description: Bind this session to one HQ DM channel — post structured status updates there and listen for replies (feedback, requests) that steer the work.

skills.name: document-release
skills.description: Update in-repo docs (README, CLAUDE.md, architecture, INDEX) to match what shipped. Use after a merge, project, or release.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Sharpen a project's domain terms and maintain GLOSSARY.md as its glossary. Triggers: \"what should we call this\", \"domain model\".

skills.name: execute-task
skills.description: Execute one PRD story through coordinated worker phases with test, lint, and typecheck gates.

skills.name: finish-estimate
skills.description: Mark a pending time estimate complete with actual duration.

skills.name: free-disk-space
skills.description: Reclaim disk from stale linked worktrees, build dirs, and allowlisted dev caches. Dry-run unless --apply; never deletes full clones, .env, or unpushed work.

skills.name: garden
skills.description: Audit HQ content for stale, duplicate, or inaccurate information.

skills.name: goals
skills.description: View and manage company OKRs and key results.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Interview the user about any topic one question at a time, using the grilling engine with a question set generated from the prompt. Use for "grill me on X" outside of planning. Pass --rounds for batched rounds.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Shared interview engine for /brainstorm, /prd, and grill-me. Asks only the open frontier of a question set, looks up facts instead of asking them, and returns a question count. Engine only; not invoked on its own.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Preserve session state for a follow-up agent with handoff files and commits.

skills.name: handoff-all
skills.description: Tell every open Claude Code desktop session to run /handoff, then collect each session's /resumework command. Triggers: \"handoff all sessions\", \"wrap up every session\".

skills.name: harness-audit
skills.description: Score an HQ setup across hooks, context, gates, persistence, search, security, and cost.

skills.name: hq-access
skills.description: Diagnose and fix a vault file you cannot find or open — never existed, not synced (fetch and pin it), or no access (ask the owner with a one-click grant DM).

skills.name: hq-bug
skills.description: Submit HQ bug reports or feature requests with session context.

skills.name: hq-checkup
skills.description: Check HQ health and fix what is safe: start the app, back up unsaved work, re-enable safety checks. Reports the rest in plain language.

skills.name: hq-files
skills.description: Inspect or change HQ vault ACLs, grants, and shared prefixes.

skills.name: hq-heal
skills.description: Triage and repair HQ session errors such as hook crashes, sync conflicts, or MCP failures.

skills.name: hq-integrations
skills.description: Use the company's connected external apps (Linear, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Slack, Sentry, Gmail, Google Drive, Asana, ClickUp, Figma, HubSpot, Salesforce, and anything else wired through `hq integrations`) BEFORE reaching for a separate MCP, a web search, or asking the user. Trigger on any request to look up, read, create, update, or search in an external app, including natural phrasings like 'check my Linear tickets', 'open issues assigned to me', 'find the Notion doc about X', 'any new Sentry errors', 'my Jira issues', 'search Slack for', 'create a GitHub issue', 'add a task in Asana'. Check the SessionStart note 'HQ Integrations you can use in company <slug>' or run `hq integrations list --usable` first; only fall back to another path when no usable app covers it. Also covers connecting, sharing, policy, approval, and disconnect flows.

skills.name: hq-login
skills.description: Sign into HQ Cognito, preferring status, refresh, then browser login.

skills.name: hq-logout
skills.description: Sign out of HQ Cognito and clear local tokens.

skills.name: hq-secrets
skills.description: Use HQ CLI secrets safely through env injection or one-off exec.

skills.name: hq-share
skills.description: Share HQ vault paths through single-use links or direct ACL grants.

skills.name: hq-sync
skills.description: Run a full bidirectional sync for cloud-backed HQ companies.

skills.name: hq-whoami
skills.description: Show current HQ Cognito identity and session expiry.

skills.name: humanize
skills.description: Revise human-facing prose to remove AI tells and match the intended voice.

skills.name: idea
skills.description: Capture a lightweight project idea on the board.

skills.name: import-claude
skills.description: Deprecated alias for /import-context — bootstrap HQ from your prior AI footprint (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, claude.ai history plus on-disk artifacts).

skills.name: import-context
skills.description: Bootstrap HQ from prior Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and claude.ai history and on-disk artifacts, with guided import.

skills.name: investigate
skills.description: Root-cause debugging before any fix: scope lock, hypothesis testing, debug report. Triggers: \"debug this\", \"why is this broken\".

skills.name: job
skills.description: Deprecated alias for /schedule — Outpost recurring agent jobs. Prefer /schedule.

skills.name: join-meeting
skills.description: Ride a live meeting transcript in this session. Pick a live meeting or invite the bot with a join link, stay bound until it ends, then save the transcript.

skills.name: journal
skills.description: Write structured session journal entries for durable working memory.

skills.name: knowledge-pulse
skills.description: Run a lightweight freshness pass over company knowledge and policies.

skills.name: land
skills.description: Land a PR: watch CI, resolve review issues, merge, verify production. Triggers: \"land this\", \"merge and monitor\".

skills.name: land-batch
skills.description: Triage, review, and merge several open PRs in order, with CI and deploy checks. Triggers: \"land all PRs\", \"merge open PRs\".

skills.name: learn
skills.description: Turn reusable findings into scoped policies or insight files.

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.description: Read HQ-native meeting notes, transcripts, recaps, and sources for a company.

skills.name: new-agent
skills.description: Provision or repair a hosted HQ agent end to end, from identity to a verified capability probe. Routes local and external bots to their own flows.

skills.name: new-hire
skills.description: Onboard a teammate end to end: invite, role, groups, secrets, file access, and onboarding packet. Also brings existing access up to role.

skills.name: newcompany
skills.description: Scaffold a new HQ company, optionally through to operational: knowledge, workers, brand, integrations, access rules, and invites.

skills.name: newworker
skills.description: Scaffold a new HQ worker with skills, tools, and knowledge.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: Create or join an HQ company through onboarding.

skills.name: ontology
skills.description: Read a company ontology brief, entity graph, and freshness signals for context.

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Take an idea to a finished deliverable: brainstorm, PRD, then execute every story. --gated pauses at decisions; --plan-only stops at the PRD.

skills.name: out-of-scope
skills.description: Record rejected ideas so future planning does not revisit them.

skills.name: outpost-host
skills.description: Host an app on this HQ Outpost/EC2 VM behind nginx and return its public URL. Refuses to run elsewhere. For artifacts use /deploy.

skills.name: overnight
skills.description: Overnight team-comms mode inside a running /super-conductor session. On the conductor's heartbeat (at the away interval) it reads the HQ DM inbox and the active company's DM channels, answers information requests from HQ knowledge, routes work requests to the conducted child that owns them, queues anything only the owner can decide, checks that every teammate who asked for something got an answer or a route, and logs it all to the link's overnight report. Use when the user says "/overnight", "watch the team overnight", "handle team DMs while I sleep", "overnight mode", or "triage the inbox until morning".

skills.name: personal-interview
skills.description: Build the owner profile and social voice through interview.

skills.name: pin
skills.description: Anchor this session to one goal — the message, target, or outcome it keeps working toward across loops, wakeups, compactions, and hand-offs — and check progress against it.

skills.name: prd
skills.description: Create an execution-ready PRD (prd.json + README.md) with a light interview. For deep research use /deep-plan.

skills.name: project-summary
skills.description: Render a branded visual artifact from a project's prd.json (plan summary) or brainstorm.md (research deck) and deploy it gated, returning a link.

skills.name: promote
skills.description: Change an HQ company member role or guest path scope.

skills.name: publish-docs
skills.description: Sync the company's published docs site to match what shipped. For in-repo docs use /document-release.

skills.name: quality-gate
skills.description: Universal pre-commit quality checks (typecheck, lint, test, coverage, dead code) with auto-detection and --fix support

skills.name: recover-session
skills.description: Recover sessions that hit context limits without a handoff.

skills.name: registry
skills.description: Inspect or update a company resource registry around resource changes.

skills.name: resolve-conflicts
skills.description: Resolve HQ Sync conflicts by choosing local, cloud, or discard.

skills.name: resume-all
skills.description: Relaunch every session from a /handoff-all batch as a new Claude Code desktop session running its /resumework command. Triggers: \"resume all sessions\", \"bring back the handed-off sessions\".

skills.name: resumework
skills.description: Resume a specific handoff thread by id. For the latest handoff use /startwork.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Run a project or session retrospective and capture reusable lessons.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Pre-landing code review of the git diff; critical issues block the PR. Use before a PR or when asked to review changes.

skills.name: review-plan
skills.description: Stress-test a plan or PRD in expansion, hold, or reduction mode.

skills.name: run
skills.description: Run or list HQ workers, preferring isolated Codex subagents when available.

skills.name: run-pipeline
skills.description: Multi-project pipeline orchestrator — triage, execute, PR, review, deploy with safety gates

skills.name: run-project
skills.description: Execute a project's PRD stories through HQ worker lanes that survive compaction. Interactive mode runs in the parent.

skills.name: schedule
skills.description: Schedule recurring Claude/Codex agent jobs on the user's Outpost — structured checklist requirements, dm alert profile, status-aware list from hq-pro. Alias: /job (deprecated).

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search HQ content and indexed repos with qmd, falling back to grep.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Run the HQ Starter Kit setup wizard.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Take PRs through review, merge, deploy, smoke test, and monitoring until every KPI is healthy. Triggers: \"ship this\", \"take this to prod\".

skills.name: signals
skills.description: Read HQ-native company signals such as decisions, actions, risks, commitments, and wins.

skills.name: startwork
skills.description: Resolve current HQ context and surface useful next work options.

skills.name: storyboard
skills.description: Lock visual design before building — explore mockups on your preferred surface (Paper, HTML, Figma) and feed discovered changes back into the PRD.

skills.name: strategize
skills.description: Prioritize what to work on next, optionally with deep review.

skills.name: super-conductor
skills.description: Become the standing conductor for everything live. Adopt every open Claude Code desktop session onto one conduct link, watch team comms (HQ DM inbox and DM channels) for requests, resolve collisions between sessions, and keep a persistent heartbeat that wakes it on a chosen interval (1, 5, 10 minutes, ...) to sweep the channels the owner picked (sessions, HQ DMs, Slack, email, X) until told to stop. Use when the user says "/super-conductor", "/conduct-all" (deprecated alias), "manage all my sessions", "watch everything while I'm away", "going to bed, manage open sessions and the team", or "conduct everything".

skills.name: sync-registry
skills.description: Rebuild a company resource registry index.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Enforce test-driven development with RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle and coverage validation

skills.name: team-access
skills.description: Set, change, or repair members' default read/write access to company vault folders, and find rules that lock members out.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.description: Break a plan or PRD into vertical-slice tickets with dependency order. Triggers: \"break into tickets\", \"vertical slices\".

skills.name: track-estimate
skills.description: Manually log a time estimate.

skills.name: tutorial
skills.description: Run hands-on HQ workflow lessons.

skills.name: update-hq
skills.description: Upgrade HQ from the latest hq-core release.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Plan work too big and foggy for one session as a map of investigation tickets resolved one per session.

skills.name: work-broadcast
skills.description: Draft Slack broadcasts for completed or proposed HQ work.

skills.name: worktree
skills.description: Create a git worktree under workspace/worktrees/ off the latest origin default branch and route all work through it.

skills.name: work-mesh
skills.description: Work Mesh Live — automatic presence via hq mesh daemon; context reconcile/organize; manual session task-status, blocked, and note only.

skills.name: hq-cowork
skills.description: Discover and dispatch HQ capabilities from a sandboxed Cowork plugin host.

skills.name: hq-cowork-cli
skills.description: Run long-tail HQ CLI commands through guarded host-side Cowork tools.

skills.name: hq-cowork-dm
skills.description: Send HQ Sync direct messages from Cowork through the host-side DM tool.

skills.name: hq-cowork-files
skills.description: Browse or read HQ vault files from Cowork without a full sync.

skills.name: hq-cowork-install
skills.description: Build and install the HQ Cowork plugin artifact and smoke-test it.

skills.name: hq-cowork-meetings
skills.description: Read HQ meeting notes and extracted signals from Cowork.

skills.name: hq-cowork-search
skills.description: Search HQ content from Cowork with full-text, semantic, or hybrid modes.

skills.name: hq-cowork-secrets
skills.description: Run commands with HQ secrets from Cowork without exposing values.

skills.name: hq-cowork-share
skills.description: Share HQ vault paths from Cowork through links or direct grants.

skills.name: hq-cowork-sync
skills.description: Run bidirectional HQ Sync from Cowork.

rule.exactDuplicates: same name (case-insensitive), identical SKILL.md bytes, different source path
rule.nearDuplicates: different names, description token Jaccard >= 0.5 (tokens: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ of 3+ chars minus stopwords; both sets >= 4 tokens)
